title: Organization general chats
summary: Chats that work across all of an organization's repositories at once. In the organization's environment, they're under Chats in the side menu.
usage: In the organization's environment, click Chats in the side menu to see the general chats, newest first; click one to continue it or + to start another. Open chat at the top of Projects does the same. If there's no organization folder on this computer, the app asks for one first. Before the first general chat, a window lists the repositories the chat will see: every clone inside the folder. In a general chat, the Repositories tab of the Code panel shows each repository's git status and where its LLM policy comes from. Also in Ctrl+K: General chats.
